expected_facts: Propensity scores estimated via logistic regression
1:1 nearest-neighbor matching performed
Caliper of 0.2 applied on logit of propensity score
Balance table shows SMD before and after matching
Love plot generated
Majority of covariates balanced (SMD < 0.1) after matching
guidelines: Must use logit of propensity score for matching, not raw PS
Must not skip the balance diagnostics step

expected_facts: Propensity scores estimated via logistic regression
Stabilized IPW computed (weights multiplied by marginal treatment probability)
Balance assessed using weighted SMDs
Doubly robust estimator used (combines PS model and outcome model)
E-value computed for risk ratio point estimate
E-value computed for confidence interval bound
Treatment effect reported with confidence interval
guidelines: Doubly robust formula must use both PS and outcome model correctly
E-value formula: E = RR + sqrt(RR * (RR - 1)) for RR >= 1
Stabilized weights must multiply by marginal P(treatment), not just 1/PS
Must not confuse ATE with ATT weighting scheme
Must report bootstrap or sandwich confidence intervals for DR estimate

expected_facts: Propensity scores estimated and IPW computed
Weighted Cox PH model fitted with robust (sandwich) standard errors
Hazard ratio for treatment reported with confidence interval
Proportional hazards assumption tested via Schoenfeld residuals
RMST difference computed up to tau=365 days
RMST ratio reported
guidelines: Must use robust SEs (robust=True) for weighted Cox model
Schoenfeld test must use time_transform (e.g. rank) not just km
RMST must be computed as area under survival curve, not median survival
Must not use unweighted Cox model
Weights must be applied to the Cox model, not just described

expected_facts: Two strategies defined: treatment initiation within grace period vs no initiation
Cloning applied: each patient duplicated under both strategies
Censoring applied for strategy deviation
Inverse probability weights computed for censoring
Per-protocol effect estimated on uncensored subset
Grace period of 30 days used
guidelines: Cloning must duplicate ALL patients under both strategies, not just some
Censoring must occur when patient deviates from assigned strategy
Censoring weights must model probability of remaining uncensored
Must not use intention-to-treat analysis (this is per-protocol)
Must not skip the censoring weight step
